subject: Integration slowdown — request for pilot cushion and sandbox credits
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightroute.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@brightroute.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot build — integration timeline slipping, need cushion

Hi Naomi,

Quick note from our side: our backend team hit an unexpected blocker with the SFTP adapter and a downstream webhook contract drift. We were targeting a live pilot next week but engineering has pushed the window out by at least two sprints (approx. 3-4 weeks).

Given the delay, were worried about losing momentum internally (execs want demo data in July). Can Redwood provide a short-term cushion — either extended sandbox access or additional credits — so we can keep the pilot on the calendar while our engineers rework the adapter?

I attached a small snippet of the logs were seeing.

[attachment: integration-debug-output.log (text/plain)]

Possible asks: 30 days extension + 200k token sandbox credit OR a 45-day window if you can help with a connector triage call.

Appreciate any flexibility,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Product
BrightRoute Inc.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightroute.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@brightroute.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot build — integration timeline slipping, need cushion

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks for the heads up and for the log excerpt — that helps. Were sympathetic to timing risk here. Im looping in Marissa for commercial and our infra folks for a technical assessment.

Short-term we can propose two options while engineering triages:
- Option A: 30-day pilot extension + 200k token sandbox credit (standard)
- Option B: 45-day pilot extension + 300k token sandbox credit + one triage hour with our connector team (paid at cost)

Can you confirm which option you'd prefer? If you want Option B Ill seek fast-track approval from revenue ops.

Next steps from our side:
- Ill ask engineering to review the attached log and estimate whether a quick patch or a small rework is required (cc: Karthik).
- If youre open, we can schedule a 30-min triage tomorrow to go through the error traces.

Naomi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 11:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot build — integration timeline slipping, need cushion (technical assessment)

Quick technical read: thanks for the log, Sanjay. The stack trace points to two issues:
1) SFTP client retries are exhausting due to an intermittent permission error (likely on BrightRoute's SFTP host).
2) The webhook payload schema changed (new required field "customer_zone") which causes a schema mismatch in our ingest adapter.

Estimated remediation effort:
- Permission / SFTP retry tuning: low effort (hours), can be addressed with configuration + brief coordination with BrightRoute IT.
- Schema mismatch: medium effort (2-4 dev days) because the adapter requires a small mapping and a regression test.

Workarounds: we can enable a temporary staging endpoint to accept the older payload shape and map it server-side; that would take ~1 day to stand up. If BrightRoute prefers that, we can do it under Option B so the pilot proceeds without a full adapter rework.

Ill attach the diagnostic dump we generated while replaying the failing webhook events.

[attachment: integration-debug-output.log (text/plain)]

Karthik
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightroute.com>, Elena Morales <elena@brightroute.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot build — integration timeline slipping, need cushion (approved)

Team / Sanjay,

After reviewing the situation and the options Naomi proposed, Redwood will approve Option B to keep the pilot timeline intact and preserve momentum with BrightRoute.

What were approving:
- 45-day pilot extension (new pilot window ends 2027-08-07)
- 300,000 token sandbox credit applied to the BrightRoute pilot account
- One (1) triage hour with our connector engineers (scheduling to follow)

Operational items Im requesting:
- Naomi: please share the updated pilot dates with BrightRoute and confirm acceptance (Sanjay).
- Karthik / Dev: please provision the temporary staging endpoint and capture any rollout notes in the attached staging plan.
- CS / Ops (cc): set up a support touchpoint and apply the credit on the account; include monitoring for webhook failures for the next 6 weeks.

Ive also created a quick DocuSign proposal to amend the pilot term to reflect the extension. Please sign when ready: https://docusign.example.com/link/BR-1247-proposal

Attachments: BrightRoute-staging-plan.pdf (internal runbook)

Thanks everyone — lets keep the momentum.

Marissa Cole
Senior Revenue Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Elena Morales <elena@brightroute.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightroute.com>, BrightRoute IT <it@brightroute.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 17:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot build — integration timeline slipping, need cushion (BrightRoute accepts)

Hi Marissa / Naomi,

Thank you — we appreciate the flexibility and the staging support offer. BrightRoute accepts Option B. Well have one of our infra engineers on the triage call and will sign the DocuSign amendment today.

Next immediate step from our side: scheduling a triage tomorrow morning PT — Ill send a calendar invite with logs attached (well also upload the full logs to the share).

Elena Morales
Program Manager, BrightRoute Inc.
